name: airfocus
title: airfocus.com
shortDescription: airfocus provides a strategic product management platform designed to enhance team alignment and decision-making. It allows users to create tailored roadmaps, manage feedback, and prioritize effectively to meet market demands. Ideal for product leaders and teams, airfocus integrates OKRs, workflows, and resource management to streamline product development. Example use case: A tech company uses airfocus to align its product strategy across multiple teams, ensuring cohesive and strategic product launches.
pros: High-level portfolio views for strategic alignment
cons: May require learning curve for new users
